title: Converting Quantum Sensing Noise into Erasures
summary: Erasures are more favorable for quantum sensing than unflagged errors such as Pauli errors. However, realistic sensing noise does not usually appear as erasures; it often acts within the same sensing Hilbert space as the signal, making it difficult to identify and mitigate. For such noise, we establish a noise-model-agnostic necessary and sufficient condition for erasure conversion, identifying the noise components that can be converted into erasures and removed without damaging the signal.
